Saved Views is available today, included in all paid plans, and gives every user the ability to save up to 50 custom views. Whether you filter tasks by assignee, sort a backlog by priority, or group work by due date, you can now save that exact setup and return to it in one click instead of rebuilding it each time.

Saved Views also make it easy to share your perspective with your team. Save a view once, share it with teammates, and everyone can jump straight into the same filtered, sorted layout without repeating the setup themselves. This is especially useful for standups, sprint planning, and reporting, where consistent, shared context matters.

To start, look for the new option in the toolbar of any list. Each saved view keeps its filters, sorting, and grouping intact, so you can switch between projects and pick up exactly where you left off. With up to 50 views per user, there's plenty of room for both personal shortcuts and shared team views.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
